failed_hard_gates.evidence: The case-handle grip and garment layer junction are coherent, but the governing norigae upper loop is hidden behind the goreum knot, and the separate pendant bail-to-cord bridge cannot be directly assessed. Those intended critical connections are not established at native scale.
